title: rql-lang: Retrieval Query Language (RQL) library (Python + TypeScript)
description:
rql-lang is a portable Retrieval Query Language (RQL) library for RAG retrieval plans. It is not a vector database. The library parses RQL text, compiles a logical plan to a vendor-capability physical plan, explains that plan, and emits vendor-request sketches. Adapters are aimed at existing engines such as Qdrant, Elasticsearch, and pgvector rather than replacing them.

This v0.1.0 snapshot implements parse → compile → explain → emit. On this tree, emit returns documentation-shaped sketches (notExecuted: true) and does not run queries against a live vector database. Live Qdrant execute/CLI and RQL Studio work exist only on unmerged draft branches and are not part of this deposit.

Development continues in a private GitHub repository. A Zenodo snapshot of this software may be public while that GitHub repository remains private. Do not treat this record as identical to a public GitHub tree. The packages are not published to PyPI or npm.
notes: Manual software deposit (GitHub-Zenodo webhook cannot be used while the source repository stays private). This record supplements the public research package and is accompanied by the public rql-repro companion. Related draft GitHub PRs for live Qdrant execute and RQL Studio are not included. No PyPI or npm release is claimed.
